scores.claim_text: Energy Storage segment had $2,710M in net sales in 2025, down from $7,079M in 2023 — material operating commercial revenue.
scores.interpretation: Albemarle is an UPSTREAM lithium chemicals producer; OEMs buy battery cells from CATL/LGES/Samsung SDI/Panasonic and would not name ALB as a direct supplier. Absence is structural, not a contradiction. The $2.7B Energy Storage revenue is real recognized GAAP revenue (segment note, large legacy base). PASS — different value-chain position per cohort metadata.

scores.claim_text: Operating mineral extraction at 4 lithium sites produced 42 thousand metric tonnes lithium metal in 2025 (Greenbushes 19, Wodgina 8, Salar de Atacama 14, Silver Peak 1).
supports: EPA FRS NV: ALBEMARLE PROPERTY in Silver Peak, NV (Esmeralda county)
EPA FRS NV: ROCKWOOD LITHIUM INC. SILVER PEAK OPERATIONS (Albemarle's predecessor entity at Silver Peak)
Multiple SILVER PEAK OPERATIONS facilities in EPA registry
scores.M_value: Confirmed Albemarle Property + Rockwood Lithium Silver Peak Operations in EPA FRS
scores.interpretation: Calibration Heuristic 1 (EPA FRS scope) — confirmed registration for US lithium production site. Production volumes 19+8+14+1=42 KT match disclosure exactly. Foreign sites (Greenbushes, Wodgina, Salar de Atacama) are not US-EPA-regulated. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Kemerton, Australia plant: Trains 3 and 4 construction stopped in 2024, Train 2 placed in care and maintenance in 2024, and Train 1 placed in care and maintenance on February 6, 2026 — all constructed trains now idled. Expected $150M-$225M cash charges in 2026.
supports: EDGAR FTS 'Kemerton' = 94 hits, predominantly Albemarle 8-Ks/10-Qs spanning 2019-2025 (construction announcement through care-and-maintenance announcements)
scores.M_value: 94 hits, all consistent with ALB's own disclosure trail
scores.interpretation: Disclosure is transparent and audit trail exists. However the substance is a HARD operational underdelivery: entire constructed Australian hydroxide conversion complex now idle within ~3 years of commissioning, $150-225M cash charges expected, $245.6M long-lived asset impairment, $510M consolidated net loss 2025 on top of $1.18B loss 2024, restructuring/impairment charges totaling >$1.4B over 2024-2025. Calibration Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational) — Kemerton was a flagship 'planned X tonnes by 20YY' lithium-hydroxide capacity claim from 2019-era investor materials; reality is full idling. MODERATE: company is being honest about the capacity rationalization, but the original capacity commitment underdelivered materially.

scores.claim_text: Refining Solutions business (Ketjen segment) divested October 2025 into 49%-owned JV with ChemCat AcquisitionCo, closing Q1 2026; $245.6M long-lived asset impairment recorded.
supports: EDGAR FTS 'ChemCat' = 7 hits: ALB 8-K 2025-10-27 (divestiture announcement), 8-K 2026-03-06 (post-close), ALB 10-K, ALB 10-Qs Q3/2025 and Q1/2026; also Grace 2018 8-K (historical Refining Solutions parent)
scores.M_value: Counterparty entity name appears in independent SEC filings; divestiture trail consistent
scores.interpretation: Transparent disclosure. The 49% retained interest converts a consolidated business to equity method, with $245.6M asset impairment booked when held-for-sale criteria were met. Standard divestiture accounting. PASS.

scores.claim_text: US production facilities include Silver Peak NV (lithium brine), Kings Mountain NC (lithium hydroxide / metal), New Johnsonville TN (butyllithium), Magnolia AR (bromine), Pasadena TX, Bayport TX, Baton Rouge LA — all should be EPA-registered.

EPA FRS NC: Albemarle Kings Mountain Mine confirmed (claim 5)
scores.M_value: NV and NC US lithium sites verified in EPA registry; bromine / butyllithium sites in AR/TN/TX not directly probed this pass but Albemarle has multi-decade production history at these legacy sites (e.g., Magnolia AR bromine operation, New Johnsonville TN butyllithium are pre-merger legacy facilities well known to regulators)
scores.interpretation: Calibration Heuristic 1 (EPA FRS scope) — direct verification of two major US production sites. Other US sites are long-established legacy chemical operations. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Customer concentration: in 2023 one Energy Storage customer was ~12% of consolidated net sales; in 2024 and 2025 no customer exceeded 10%.
scores.interpretation: Calibration Heuristic 2 (foreign-issuer caveat) for Honda; structural value-chain interpretation for Ford. ALB sells lithium hydroxide / carbonate to Tier-1 battery cell makers (LGES, Samsung SDI, Panasonic, CATL — all foreign filers or no SEC filing) who in turn supply OEMs. Geographic revenue mix corroborates this: South Korea $789M, China $2,026M, Japan $360M = 62% of total — exactly where the battery cell makers are located. Customer concentration disclosure is bounded and consistent. PASS.

supports: Recent filings include 'PROCESSES FOR EXTRACTING METALS FROM LITHIUM-ION BATTERIES' (2025-10), 'ALTERED SOLID ELECTROLYTE INTERFACE LITHIUM ANODES' (2025-08), 'CATHODE ACTIVE MATERIALS COMPRISING A LITHIUM-CONTAINING CERAMIC COATING' (2025-07), 'LITHIUM NICKEL OXIDE SYNTHESIS' (2025-09)
scores.M_value: 73 granted patents, 678 applications, deep coverage in lithium / battery / cathode / electrolyte / bromine
scores.interpretation: Calibration Heuristic 8 (Patents) — far above PASS threshold (n_granted >= 10 with claimed-tech hits). Recent applications include solid-electrolyte-interface lithium anodes and cathode active materials — directly relevant to next-gen battery cohort. Strong PASS.
